name: Sandra Kim
goals: Build real-time shipment tracking dashboard for customers
Automate SLA breach alerts to operations team
communication_style: Process-oriented, describes workflows in step-by-step terms, non-technical, wants things to work without maintenance
pain_points: Warehouse staff still use paper forms, data entry takes 3 hours daily
Customers call to ask where their shipment is, no self-service tracking
SLA breaches discovered reactively, always firefighting
sample_prompts: Build a mobile-friendly warehouse intake form that scans barcodes and logs into our inventory system automatically
Create a customer-facing shipment tracking portal that shows real-time status from our carrier APIs
Build an automated SLA monitoring system that sends Slack and email alerts when a shipment is at risk of breaching
